subject: product of fixed and random effects in INLA

messages.author: 996fe8a741b3deb6
messages.subject: product of fixed and random effects in INLA
parts:
Hello,

I want to fit the following model to a dataset using INLA:

  Y_{i,j}  is  Poisson( mu_{i,j} ),   i = 1, ..., n, j = 1, ..., m,
 
  log mu_{i,j} = a_{i} + b_{i} c_{j} + v_{j}

  a_{i} and b_{i} are fixed effects
  c_{j} is an AR(1) random effect
  v_{j} is an iid random effect

Is it possible to fit such a model in R-INLA? If so, what would be the correct model formula?

  Y ~ a + b ?? f(j, model="ar1") + f(j, model="iid")

Many thanks in advance.

Best regards,

Abdollah

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] product of fixed and random effects in INLA

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] product of fixed and random effects in INLA
parts:
Hi,
The nonlinear predictor approximation method in the inlabru package can handle this.
See inlabru.org for tutorial examples. There are some quirks in how one needs to define the formula to make the optimizer work, but it’s mostly a matter of defining he model components and then providing an R expression evaluating the desired predictor expression.

Finn
